Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: Step 3 is responsible because it caused the Planner to instruct WebSurfer without clear search criteria, leading to inefficient data retrieval and potential misinterpretation of historical geographical layouts, which in turn skewed subsequent analysis and conclusions.

Step Range: 0-2  
The Oracle: WebSurfer  
Evidence: Initial web searches to gather information on the importance of matching fossils and their role in supporting the continental drift theory.  
Loop Info:  
is_loop_related: false

loop_risk_score: 0  

The Subtask Name: Research Historical Layouts  
Step Range: 3-6  
The Oracle: WebSurfer  
Evidence: Conducting web searches to understand the historical geographical arrangement of South America and Africa based on geological evidence.  
Loop Info:  
is_loop_related: false  
loop_role: none  
loop_group_id: null  
reversibility: irreversible  
loop_risk_score: 0  

The Subtask Name: Evaluate Hypotheses  
Step Range: 7-12  
The Oracle: Planner

Loop Info:  
is_loop_related: false  
loop_role: none

reversibility: irreversible  
loop_risk_score: 0  

The Subtask Name: Correlate Timelines  
Step Range: 13-18  
The Oracle: WebSurfer

Loop Info:  
is_loop_related: false

loop_group_id: null

loop_risk_score: 0
